<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="lVWJE368AFDnBdMqMhZ3"> <mxGraphModel dx="3097" dy="1897" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml Agile_Workspace_ERD
left to right direction
hide circle
hide empty methods
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam roundcorner 8
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam dpi 150
skinparam nodesep 35
skinparam ranksep 55

skinparam defaultFontName \"Segoe UI\"
skinparam defaultFontSize 12

skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F8FAFC
 BorderColor #CBD5E1
 FontColor #1E293B
 FontStyle bold
}

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 HeaderBackgroundColor #EEF2FF
 BorderColor #94A3B8
 ArrowColor #475569
 FontColor #0F172A
 AttributeFontSize 11.5
}

' 1. NHÓM NGƯỜI DÙNG & XÁC THỰC (4 BẢNG)
package \"1. Người dùng & Xác thực (Auth)\" #F5F7FF {
 entity \"users\" as users {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * email : VARCHAR(255) <<UQ>>
 * username : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
 password_hash : VARCHAR(255)
 * full_name : VARCHAR(150)
 avatar_url : VARCHAR(500)
 * system_role : ENUM('admin','user')
 * is_active : BOOLEAN
 * token_version : INT
 last_login_at : DATETIME
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"oauth_accounts\" as oauth_accounts {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * provider : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
 * provider_user_id : VARCHAR(255) <<UQ>>
 access_token : TEXT
 refresh_token : TEXT
 token_expires_at : DATETIME
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"password_reset_tokens\" as password_reset_tokens {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * token_hash : CHAR(64) <<UQ>>
 * expires_at : DATETIME
 used_at : DATETIME
 * created_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"revoked_tokens\" as revoked_tokens {
 * **id** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 * jti : VARCHAR(64) <<UQ>>
 * expires_at : DATETIME
 * revoked_at : DATETIME
 }
}

' 2. NHÓM DỰ ÁN, PHÂN QUYỀN & LỜI MỜI (3 BẢNG)
package \"2. Dự án & Phân quyền RBAC\" #F0FDF4 {
 entity \"projects\" as projects {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * name : VARCHAR(200)
 description : TEXT
 * owner_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * status : ENUM('active','completed','archived')
 start_date : DATE
 end_date : DATE
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 deleted_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"project_members\" as project_members {
 * **project_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 * **user_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 --
 * role : ENUM('owner','manager','member','viewer')
 * joined_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"project_invitations\" as project_invitations {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 inviter_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * invitee_email : VARCHAR(255)
 invitee_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * role : ENUM('manager','member','viewer')
 * token : CHAR(64) <<UQ>>
 * status : ENUM('pending','accepted','declined','expired','cancelled')
 * expires_at : DATETIME
 * created_at : DATETIME
 responded_at : DATETIME
 pending_email : VARCHAR(255) <<VIRTUAL>>
 }
}

' 3. NHÓM BẢNG KANBAN, NHÃN & CÔNG VIỆC (5 BẢNG)
package \"3. Bảng Kanban & Công việc\" #FFFBEB {
 entity \"lists\" as lists {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * name : VARCHAR(100)
 * position : INT
 * is_done_column : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"labels\" as labels {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * name : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
 * color : CHAR(7)
 * created_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"tasks\" as tasks {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * list_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * title : VARCHAR(500)
 description : TEXT
 * priority : ENUM('low','medium','high','urgent')
 * position : INT
 start_date : DATETIME
 due_date : DATETIME
 completed_at : DATETIME
 * created_by : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 deleted_at : DATETIME
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"task_assignees\" as task_assignees {
 * **task_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 * **user_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 --
 * assigned_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"task_labels\" as task_labels {
 * **task_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 * **label_id** : BIGINT <<PK, FK>>
 }
}

' 4. NHÓM CỘNG TÁC, THÔNG BÁO & NHẬT KÝ HOẠT ĐỘNG (5 BẢNG)
package \"4. Cộng tác, Thông báo & Nhật ký\" #EFF6FF {
 entity \"checklist_items\" as checklist_items {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * task_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * content : VARCHAR(500)
 * is_done : BOOLEAN
 * position : INT
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"comments\" as comments {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * task_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * content : TEXT
 * created_at : DATETIME
 * updated_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"attachments\" as attachments {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * task_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * file_name : VARCHAR(255)
 * file_path : VARCHAR(500)
 * file_size : BIGINT
 mime_type : VARCHAR(100)
 * created_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"notifications\" as notifications {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * type : ENUM(19_event_types)
 * title : VARCHAR(255)
 message : TEXT
 entity_type : VARCHAR(50)
 entity_id : BIGINT
 * is_read : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : DATETIME
 }

 entity \"activity_logs\" as activity_logs {
 * **id** : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * project_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 task_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * user_id : BIGINT <<FK>>
 * entity_type : VARCHAR(50)
 entity_id : BIGINT
 * action : VARCHAR(50)
 old_value : TEXT
 new_value : TEXT
 * created_at : DATETIME
 }
}

' QUAN HỆ KHOÁ NGOẠI (CROW'S FOOT)
users ||--o{ oauth_accounts : \"liên kết OAuth2\"
